set.body: Scope: PRD Phases 8-10. Move cross-domain code into explicit interop modules, normalize the NeuroArchive manifest with pure legacy translation, retire canonical legacy dispatch, and complete the reusable law and conformance suites. Close only when build edges match the target DAG, archive core contains no scientific reconstruction, latent core contains no physical archive mechanics, dataset core contains no format or representation dispatch, old and new fixtures read, the canonical writer emits the admitted new form, and compileAll plus testAll pass warning-clean.
set.title: EPIC RRA-D: module extraction, manifest vNext, and release laws
